newsitem.title: UK: SBC Warburg makes new emerging market appointments. [CORRECTED 23:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg makes new emerging market appointments. [CORRECTED 23:45 GMT]

text.p: SBC Warburg said on Tuesday it had appointed Rodney Ward to lead the bank's drive into emerging markets in Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

"Rodney Ward... will spearhead an increased focus on emerging markets in Europe, the Middle East and Africa. He will also play a senior role with major international clients of the group," the bank said in a statement released in London.
Ward, who was previously chairman of SBC Warburg's Asia Pacific region, will be replaced there by Luqman Arnold, who joins the firm from Banque Paribas.

Arnold (corrects from Ward) is the first outside appointment to SBC Warburg's executive board since the firm was created in July 1995, and will be responsible for further developing SBC Warburg's investment banking in the Asia Pacific region, the statement said. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
